howToPlay.title: How to Play
items: Left click (tap) to open a cell. The first click is always safe and opens an area
Right click or long-press (0.35 s) to flag. On mobile, turn on Flag mode to flag with a tap
Click an opened number (or press both / middle button) to open its neighbors when the flags match
Keyboard: focus the board, move with arrows, Space/Enter to open, F to flag
If the expert board is larger than your screen, shrink it with the Cell size slider or drag to pan

tips.title: Strategy Tips
items: When a number equals its adjacent flags, the rest are safe. Click the number to open them all
Learn patterns like 1-2-1 and 1-2-2-1 to clear edges quickly
Turn on No-guess board to solve with logic alone, no luck needed
Only flag where you need to chord. Fewer clicks means higher efficiency

whatIs.title: What is Minesweeper?
whatIs.description: Minesweeper is the classic grid puzzle game where you use number clues to locate hidden mines and safely reveal all non-mine cells. Familiar to generations of Windows users, it offers beginner, intermediate, expert, and custom difficulty modes. An excellent way to exercise logical deduction and focus.

items.q: Can I hit a mine on the first click?
items.a: No. No mines are placed on the first cell or its 8 neighbors, so the first click is always safe and opens an area.
After generating a board we check that it can be solved with basic deduction rules; if not, we regenerate. You never face a 50:50 guess.

items.q: Is the daily board the same for everyone?
items.a: Yes. Everyone gets the same intermediate board for the KST date, with one try per day and a shareable result.
3BV is the minimum clicks needed to solve the board; efficiency is 3BV divided by your clicks. Good chording can push it above 100%.
On your first opened cell, measured to 1/100 of a second.
